facts.fact: NITDA's National Cloud Investment Strategy (August 2026) says the National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy (2020-2030) established Nigeria's long-term vision for a digitally enabled economy and continues to provide the overarching national policy framework; the stated period runs to 2030, and the strategy lists it among its foundational documents, but the passage does not say whether the text is public.
